constraints: Bids only when confident in value
agents.name: Agent A

agents.goal: Secure the item at the lowest possible price
agents.name: Agent C

causes.hypothesis: Higher confidence leads to higher bids
causes.name: Bidder A's confidence

causes.hypothesis: More aggressive bidding increases final price
causes.name: Bidder B's aggressiveness

causes.hypothesis: Lower budget limits reduce final price
causes.name: Bidder C's budget limit

interaction.stopping_rule: Auction ends when a bidder places a bid above the current highest bid and no further bids are placed

outcome.measurement_question: What is the final selling price of the art piece?
outcome.name: Final auction price
outcome.operationalization: The final price the art piece is sold for in the auction

scenario: 3 bidders participating in an auction for a piece of art starting at fifty dollars
